sentences.en: The leader of the new republic is buckling under political pressures.
sentences.zh: 这个新共和国的领导人正承受着政治压力。

sentences.en: Buckle up, sit down, shut up and hold on.
sentences.zh: 系好安全带，坐下来，闭嘴，抓紧了。

sentences.en: In these times of crisis, many people have to buckle down.
sentences.zh: 在这些危机时刻，许多人不得不全力以赴。

senses.zh: 扣住，弯曲，专心做事，屈服
